messages:
elaine: Quick sync — we need a concrete decomposition for the inference topology for the next 18 months. Major constraints: routing policy flexibility, multi-region failover, tenant isolation (soft vs hard), and predictable SLAs for customers asking for dedicated capacity + data locality.

sam: Clarify scope — do we centralize policy decisions in a global control plane and push execution to regions, or keep policy local to regions?

devin: Proposal: 3-layer pattern to balance control vs local performance:
- Global control plane: policy config, placement decisions, rollout orchestration
- Regional routing plane: low-latency enforcement, health-based failover, cost/latency tradeoffs
- Tenant slice layer: per-tenant affinity, KV cache boundaries, optional hard isolation

maria: What are realistic launch criteria for Phase 1? Customers want contracts.

elaine: Phase 1 (Q3 planning): policy fabric + soft-affinity + regional failover + metrics. Must meet: P50 token latency within 60ms for primary small models, <2x baseline tail latency, canary rollback path, observability (per-tenant cost + latency).

ash: Concern: early tenant slicing kills packing. Need a cost model that shows when dedicated slices make sense vs. soft affinity.

devin: We'll include packing simulation and utilization targets: target GPU util >70% for shared mode, and cost/performance delta for slice mode.

infra-bot: [deploy-bot] Perf harness started: run_id=rt-20250401-17. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/run/rt-20250401-17

maria: Important customer asks: EU data locality + private VPC. How do we gate those into the plan?

sam: Gate by contract: EU-regulated customers => require Phase 2 (regional pins + region KMS + verified compliance), otherwise Phase 1 is sufficient.

elaine: Phasing suggestion (planning doc will reflect this):
- Phase 1: Soft affinity, global policy, regional failover, rollout tooling — ship to hosted + dedicated.
- Phase 2: Tenant regional pins, isolation lanes (soft/hard), KMS regional support — gated by enterprise contracts & perf.
- Phase 3: Full hard isolation and private/on-prem packaging — early-adopter enterprise program, security signoff required.

ash: Action items:
- @devin: build cost model + packing simulation (ETA 2w)
- @sam: proto control-plane policy API + example rules (ETA 1w)
- @maria: customer priority list for locality + contracts (ETA 1w)
- @elaine: schedule customer advisory call next Tue and open RFC PR (ETA 3d)

maria: Suggest adding a customer-visible "fallback-cost" knob so customers can opt into cheaper fallbacks with clear latency expectations.

devin: That maps neatly to routing rules: prefer primary region and model variant, fallback to cheaper region/quantized variant with explicit SLO.

elaine: Sounds good. We'll treat this as the baseline for the roadmap doc. I'll draft the spec with phases, launch criteria, and telemetry requirements and link the perf runs. Expect RFC tomorrow morning.

sam: :thumbsup:

maria: :+1:
